compiled_state.title: [agent background loop]: PR-status until-loop keeps polling after CI failure -> wastes runtime / hides failure from operator until manual check
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Scenario
During the 2026-05-17 batch-fix session, I started PRs in a loop and used a background Bash with `until [ "$(gh pr view N --json state -q .state)" = "MERGED" ]; do sleep 30; done` to wait for each PR to merge. The until-condition only watches for MERGED, with no escape for FAILURE/CLOSED/CHECKS_FAILED states.

### Expected Behavior
The polling loop should also terminate (and return non-zero) when:
- One or more required status checks have conclusion=FAILURE
- The PR is closed without merging
- Auto-merge is disabled
The operator should be notified that the PR cannot merge so the next bug isn't started prematurely.

### Actual Behavior
For PR #182 (c716-952a sprint SKILL.md fix), Script Tests failed at 7m53s with two test failures (test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh, test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh). The CI failure made auto-merge unreachable. My background `until` loop continued polling for MERGED every 30s — the loop has no exit condition for the failure state, so it would have run until the harness 1h timeout. Discovered only when the user told me checks were failing.

### Impact
- Wasted background-job budget polling a doomed PR
- Session blocks on a PR that will never merge until operator notices
- Cascade risk: while the loop polls, downstream agents ("next bug") cannot start because the gating instruction says 'verify each PR has merged successfully before starting on the next bug'

### Suggested Fix
The wait-for-merge helper should query `statusCheckRollup` alongside `state` and exit non-zero when:
- any required check conclusion == FAILURE/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT, OR
- PR state transitions to CLOSED (not MERGED), OR
- auto-merge was queued but is now disabled

Pseudocode:
```bash
while true; do
  read state checks_failed <<< $(gh pr view $PR --json state,statusCheckRollup \
    -q '.state + " " + ([.statusCheckRollup[]?|select(.conclusion=="FAILURE")]|length|tostring)')
  case "$state" in
    MERGED) exit 0 ;;
    CLOSED) echo 'PR closed without merge'; exit 2 ;;
  esac
  [[ "$checks_failed" -gt 0 ]] && { echo 'CI checks failing'; exit 3; }
  sleep 30
done
```

### Skills and Workflows
- Pattern: orchestrator agents using Bash `run_in_background: true` with `until` loops to wait for PR merge
- This is operator-level helper code, not currently a documented DSO skill — but the pattern is recurring across /dso:sprint, /dso:fix-bug, and ad-hoc batch sessions
- Affected: ANY caller using the bare-MERGED until-loop
